newsitem.title: USA: Western Pacific expects Q4 operating loss.
newsitem.headline: Western Pacific expects Q4 operating loss.

text.p: Western Pacific Airlines Inc said on Friday it expects to report a "significant" operating loss for the fourth quarter of 1996.

The company said it also would take one-time charges from severance costs, write-downs and costs relating to the start-up of its Mountain Air Express subsidiary and the expected operating loss for the quarter also includes a loss related to Mountain Air.
Western Pacific also said two major stockholders will each invest another $10 million in the company, in the form of loans converted into preferred stock and warrants.
Hunt Petroleum Co of Texas Inc and GFI Co will each receive 100,000 shares of Series B preferred stock, and 1.325 million warrants exercisible into common stock.
